result.summary: Found 1 visual layout issue where a restaurant title is unexpectedly clipped despite available space.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' is clipped on the right (the final 'n' is cut off, appearing as 'Tokumaru Rameı'), even though there is plenty of horizontal space before the star rating '4.8 (500+)'.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the title container's width or flex constraints so the text is not prematurely clipped, and apply proper text-overflow ellipsis only if it actually reaches the rating element.
